title: NASA-UAP-D017, Preliminary Gemini 4 Crew Debriefing, Part II, 1965
doc_notes: This is a declassified NASA Gemini 4 flight crew debriefing transcript; it contains no UAP or extraterrestrial encounter reports. / This is a declassified NASA Gemini 4 crew debriefing transcript containing reports of anomalous visual sightings during the mission.

encounters.summary: During the countdown, the pilot observed a multitude of wasps crawling on the spacecraft windows and the R and R section, which he jokingly noted appeared confused by the RCS nozzle.
encounters.entity_behavior: crawling on windows and R and R section
encounters.quote: a multitude of wasps sitting on the Rand R section and crawling all over the windows

encounters.summary: During orbital flight, the crew observed parallel running lines of lights radiating from the earth up toward them, appearing like a curtain or aurora, which moved in a wiggling motion.
encounters.entity_behavior: wiggling back and forth like neon signs
encounters.quote: parallel running lines of lights radiating from the earth up toward us
